answer: A farm that controls the author cannot also supply the quorum, because each signer must be independent on the onyx graph and each risks its bond. Because the ridge release is entered with every signature, the reef audit reveals the quorum and a forged release is rejected on replay. The escrow releases only against a quorum of 8 signatures from independent verifiers, so no single key can unlock a payout early. That is 2 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
